verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents broad programmatic coverage. Its REST and GraphQL APIs manage products, orders, customers and store settings, the API suite is built to automate store processes, and storefronts can run fully headless. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI-to-API parity. API credentials themselves are created in the control panel UI (Settings > API Accounts), and one community report describes unreliable API connections due to throttling. Missing for 10: an explicit or verified claim of UI/API parity, a documented coverage map of admin features exposed via API, programmatic credential provisioning, and independent hands-on confirmation of complete coverage.
